messages:
kai (partnerships): quick sync: we need a short playbook for SKU floors + reservation slope behavior for marketplace private offers. keep things simple for partners and sales.
lina-pricing: propose two simple levers: sku_floor (min mo usage) and slope_bands = [trial, ramp, committed]. define clear non-stacking rule.
tom-legal: agree on simplicity. no auto-renew unless explicit opt-in. marketing credits must be timeboxed and capped in the addendum.
rafa-sales: sales needs: 1) one-pager with floor examples (e.g., 50 GPU-hrs/mo => $X/mo), 2) SFDC calc template, 3) clear talking points around ramp credits.
devin-ops: ops asks: provide a machine-readable credit policy (JSON) and meter->sku mapping. example: {"sku":"redwood.dedicated.gpu.xlarge","floor_hours":"50","bands":"trial/ramp/committed"} (one-liner).
nina-marketing: for launch, prefer not to publicize floors prominently; position as "flexible commit paths" and highlight pilot incentives. need 2 weeks for assets.
ai (bot): reminder: create ticket in partnerships tracker for orchestration items.
kai (partnerships): action items:
- tom-legal: draft addendum language for floors & marketing credits by Tue EOD
- lina-pricing: publish slope band numbers + non-stackable rules by Wed
- devin-ops: create credit-policy JSON stub + meter mapping by Fri
- rafa-sales: SFDC calc template and pilot list by Fri
- nina-marketing: outline promo + co-brand checklist by next Tue
please reply if any timing conflicts. :handshake:
